text: NPC gear-up scoring is combat-aligned. weight_hit_share = 6.0 in src/npc_gear_up.cpp scales the hit-share term against encumbrance; hit_share() scores coverage by anatomy hit_size share. If NPCs still under-dress, that constant is the dial.

MAX_WORN_PER_TYPE = 2 at game_constants.h:38, so the engine allows a second pair of eyewear. finalize_post_armor at item_factory.cpp:1029-1041 auto-fills sub_coverage from covers, which is why glasses carry eyes_left/eyes_right sub-parts.

The Cataclysm user directory is the current working directory because init_user_dir(".") runs at main.cpp:687 with USE_HOME_DIR unset. Any launch script must cd to the install directory first or saves land wherever the shortcut pointed.
SDL3 forces the renderer order gpu,direct3d12,direct3d11,opengl on Win32 at sdltiles.cpp:608, so the RENDERER key in options.json is ignored on Windows.

codemem resolves its encoder as process.env.CODEMEM_EMBEDDING_MODEL || "Xenova/bge-small-en-v1.5" at core/dist/index.js:9438. The shipped default is English-only; multilingual works solely because the user environment sets multilingual-e5-small.

The memory_vectors virtual table is declared vec0(embedding float[384], memory_id, chunk_index, content_hash, model) at index.js:1111. The dimension is hardcoded, so moving to a 768-dim encoder is a schema migration plus a full re-embed, not a config change.

Select-Object aggregates the whole pipeline before emitting, which cancels the line buffering of python -u and makes a long run look hung. Run bare or pipe through Tee-Object when you need live output.
host_config.h:151 in CUDA 11.8 rejects _MSC_VER >= 1940, so nvcc falls back to the VS2019 toolchain even when VS2022 17.14 is installed. Deleting the 2019 install breaks every nvcc build.
Syncing the source tree into WSL needs rsync --checksum. Without it ninja sees no changes at all, because modification times come across the 9p boundary wrong.
Reciprocal rank fusion with k=60 is the fusion used by the contextual retrieval writeup: take roughly the top 150 fused candidates, then rerank down to 20.
Konsol kod sayfası ibm857 olduğu için UTF-8 çıktısı bozuluyor. Programın kendi stdout kodlamasını ayarlaması gerekiyor, aksi halde Türkçe karakterler ve emoji okunmaz hale geliyor.

Tek bir RTX 3060 Ti var ve 8 GB belleği paylaşımlı. Ağır bir iş başlatmadan önce nvidia-smi ile kimin kullandığına bakmak gerekiyor; çalışan bir eğitimi öldürmek saatlerce birikmiş checkpoint kaybı demek.

Here-string kullanarak commit mesajı yazmak metni bozuyor: ters tırnak kaçış karakteri gibi davranıyor, iç tırnaklar yeniden ayrıştırılıyor. Mesajı geçici bir dosyaya yazıp git commit -F ile vermek gerekiyor.
